name.zh-CN: 手术与术后用药时间线

zh-CN: 手术与术后用药时间线

text.zh-CN: 住院第9天行三尖瓣生物瓣置换、二尖瓣成形及房颤消融。术后第1天开始华法林；第8天房颤复发加用胺碘酮。其后INR渐升，虽两次下调华法林，第16天仍出现血尿。
text.en: On hospital day 9 she had bioprosthetic tricuspid replacement, mitral repair and AF ablation. Warfarin began on postoperative day 1; amiodarone was added for recurrent AF on day 8. INR rose and haematuria occurred on day 16 despite two warfarin reductions.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.en: Baseline INR 1.0; postoperative days 3, 8, 14 and 15 showed 1.3, 1.9, 2.2 and 2.4, respectively. On day 16 PT was 60.0 seconds and INR 5.1.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 术前尿常规及泌尿系统超声无异常；第16天肉眼血尿，尿红细胞300/μL。
text.en: Preoperative urinalysis and urinary ultrasound were unremarkable; on day 16 visible haematuria accompanied urinary RBCs of 300/µL.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 正文未列血尿时血红蛋白下降幅度、血流动力学或输血需求；不能据现有资料自动分为大出血或轻微出血。
text.en: The haemoglobin change, haemodynamics at the time of bleeding and transfusion needs are not reported; available evidence does not establish a major or minor bleeding category.

text.zh-CN: 报告停华法林并使用维生素K后PT/INR下降，次日尿红细胞阴性，降低华法林后复用并出院。原文肌注维生素K的处理保留为历史事实，不供复制。远期INR稳定性、再次出血和血栓结局未记载。
text.en: The report withheld warfarin and used vitamin K, after which PT/INR fell and urinary RBCs were negative the next day. Warfarin was restarted at a lower dose before discharge. Historical intramuscular vitamin K is recorded but not endorsed. Long-term INR stability, recurrent bleeding and thrombosis are not documented.

conclusion.zh-CN: 临床时间线支持抗凝药相互作用；风险可在添加药物后延迟显现，需要持续复核。
conclusion.en: The clinical timeline supports an anticoagulant interaction whose risk may emerge after a delay and requires continued review.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 药物相互作用的效应不必在第一剂后立刻出现。
keyReasoning.en: The effect of a drug interaction need not appear immediately after the first dose.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 纠正出血后仍需重新平衡抗凝与血栓风险。
keyReasoning.en: After bleeding correction, anticoagulation and thrombotic risk must be reassessed.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
